$comment: English name and purpose of each operation of spec/funnelchat.json (the portal's published specification), by operationId, or by "METHOD /path" for an operation without one (GET /api/v1/me). The specification is in Spanish and is copied as is (its SHA-256 is checked), so scripts/generate.mjs takes the texts the node shows from here. An operation without an entry does not stop the generation: the node shows its route as its name and the generator lists it to be translated here. It also has six alert operations the portal does not publish yet (creating, updating and deleting a destination, its verification code and its webhook test), so they come in already translated.

contact.index.name: List contacts
contact.index.purpose: Use it to search and segment contacts from your system: filter by name, phone, email, tags, custom fields, country, creation date or lead score. It is the basis for syncing or exporting your CRM.

contact.store.name: Create a contact
contact.store.purpose: Creates a new contact (phone or WhatsApp ID, name, email) when you know it does not exist. If you are not sure, use Create or update a contact.

contact.updateOrCreate.name: Create or update a contact
contact.updateOrCreate.purpose: Use it to sync contacts from your system without duplicates: if the phone already exists it updates that contact, otherwise it creates one. It is the safe option for retries.

contact.attachCustomField.name: Set a custom field on contacts
contact.attachCustomField.purpose: Use it to store your own business data on contacts (plan, city, purchase date): sets custom field values on one or more contacts in a single call.

contact.detachCustomField.name: Remove a custom field from contacts
contact.detachCustomField.purpose: Clears the value of a custom field on one or more contacts, for example when the data is out of date in your system.

contact.show.name: Get a contact
contact.show.purpose: Use it to get the full record of a contact: data, custom fields, conversation status, unread messages and last message.

contact.update.name: Update a contact
contact.update.purpose: Keeps a contact's record up to date from your system: name, email, phone, notes, assigned agent, favorite, or whether it can run flows.

contact.tags.name: List a contact's tags
contact.tags.purpose: Use it to know which tags a contact has, for example to reflect its segment in your CRM or decide what to do next.

contact.customFields.name: List a contact's custom fields
contact.customFields.purpose: Reads the custom field values of a contact, with a search by field name.

contact.metaWindow.name: Get a contact's 24-hour window
contact.metaWindow.purpose: Use it before writing to a contact to know whether its Meta 24-hour window is open on a number, and so whether you can send a free-form message or need a template.

contact.contactsByDevice.name: List a number's contacts
contact.contactsByDevice.purpose: Lists the contacts of one of your connected numbers, useful if you handle several numbers and want to split the base by number.

contact.destroy.name: Delete contacts
contact.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete contacts in bulk: by IDs, by filters (tags, custom fields, country, creation date) or all of them. Meant for large clean-ups of the base.

contactNote.index.name: List a contact's notes
contactNote.index.purpose: Reads the notes the team left on a contact, with author and date, and searches them by text.

contactNote.store.name: Add a note to a contact
contactNote.store.purpose: Use it to record on the contact something that happened in your system, such as a call, a purchase or a complaint.

contactNote.destroy.name: Delete a note
contactNote.destroy.purpose: Deletes a contact's note that is out of date or was added by mistake.

conversation.index.name: List conversations
conversation.index.purpose: Use it to build your own inbox or sync conversations: filter by number, agent, tags, kanban stage, unread or lead score, and get only what changed with updated_since.

conversation.countUnread.name: Count unread conversations
conversation.countUnread.purpose: Shows a count of unread conversations, for example in a badge or a dashboard, filtered by agents or favorites.

conversation.countOpen.name: Count open conversations
conversation.countOpen.purpose: Use it to measure the current workload: how many conversations are open, in total or per agent.

conversation.countClosed.name: Count closed conversations
conversation.countClosed.purpose: Counts closed conversations, for example for service metrics per agent.

conversation.countAll.name: Count all conversations
conversation.countAll.purpose: Use it to get the total number of conversations, as the basis to compute the share of open, closed or unread ones.

conversation.markAllAsRead.name: Mark all as read
conversation.markAllAsRead.purpose: Clears all unread counts at once, for example when you already answered through another channel; it can be limited to agents or favorites.

conversation.markAllAsUnread.name: Mark all as unread
conversation.markAllAsUnread.purpose: Use it to mark a set of conversations (by agents or favorites) as unread again so the team picks them up. It has a cap and the response says whether it was reached.

conversation.getLatestMessages.name: List a contact's messages
conversation.getLatestMessages.purpose: Gets a contact's message history and keeps it in sync in your system, with cursor pagination and updated_since to ask only for what is new.

messageReaction.update.name: React to a message
messageReaction.update.purpose: Use it to react with an emoji to a message of a conversation, for example to acknowledge it without writing a reply.

messageReaction.destroy.name: Remove a reaction
messageReaction.destroy.purpose: Removes the reaction you put on a message.

messageTemplate.templates.name: List templates
messageTemplate.templates.purpose: Use it to list your WhatsApp templates with their approval status, category, language and number, and pick the one to use in a send or a broadcast.

messageTemplate.store.name: Create a template
messageTemplate.store.purpose: Creates a WhatsApp template (header, body with variables, footer and buttons) from your system, without going through the dashboard.

messageTemplate.template.name: Get a template
messageTemplate.template.purpose: Shows a full template, with its status, variables and buttons, for example to know which values to fill in when sending it.

messageTemplate.update.name: Update a template
messageTemplate.update.purpose: Use it to edit the content of an existing template: category, header, body, variables, footer or buttons.

messageTemplate.delete.name: Delete a template from a number
messageTemplate.delete.purpose: Use it to delete a template from one of your numbers when you no longer need it.

tag.index.name: List tags
tag.index.purpose: Lists the account's tags, optionally with how many contacts each one has, to get their IDs to filter or segment.

tag.store.name: Create a tag
tag.store.purpose: Use it to create a tag (name, description, color) and segment contacts by your business criteria.

tag.show.name: Get a tag
tag.show.purpose: Shows a tag and, if you ask for it, how many contacts have it.

tag.update.name: Update a tag
tag.update.purpose: Use it to rename a tag or change its description or color.

tag.contacts.name: List the contacts with a tag
tag.contacts.purpose: Gets all the contacts that have a tag, for example to export a segment or sync it with another tool.

tag.destroy.name: Delete tags
tag.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete several tags at once.

customField.index.name: List custom fields
customField.index.purpose: Use it to know the account's custom fields and their IDs before reading or writing that data on your contacts.

customField.store.name: Create a custom field
customField.store.purpose: Creates a new custom field (for example plan or purchase date) to store your own business data in Funnelchat.

customField.destroy.name: Delete custom fields
customField.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete in bulk the custom fields you no longer use.

customField.show.name: Get a custom field
customField.show.purpose: Shows the definition of a custom field: name, type, description and how many contacts have it.

customField.update.name: Update a custom field
customField.update.purpose: Use it to rename a custom field or update its description; its type cannot be changed here.

group.index.name: List groups
group.index.purpose: Use it to list your account's groups filtered by type, status, number or without a campaign, for example to sync them with your system.

group.groups.name: List the groups a number manages
group.groups.purpose: Shows the groups a number manages according to the WhatsApp provider, for example to find groups you have not added to a campaign yet.

group.adGroups.name: List a number's announcement groups
group.adGroups.purpose: Use it to list the announcement groups a number manages (the response says which community each belongs to), for example to choose which to add to a campaign.

group.channels.name: List a number's channels
group.channels.purpose: Lists the WhatsApp channels of a number and gets their identifiers.

groupMetadata.show.name: Get a group's current data on WhatsApp
groupMetadata.show.purpose: Use it to read live from WhatsApp the current name, photo, description, link and admins of a group or channel, for example to check they match what you expect.

group.show.name: Get a group
group.show.purpose: Shows the details of a group: admins, whether the owner is connected, clicks, invite and campaign links, and whether it is full.

group.actions.name: List the session actions on a group
group.actions.purpose: Use it to see the history of actions run on a group and their result, for example to understand why its name or its admins changed.

group.scheduledMessages.name: List the scheduled sends that include a group
group.scheduledMessages.purpose: Use it to know which scheduled sends include a group, for example before changing it.

campaign.participantEvents.name: List a campaign's joins and leaves
campaign.participantEvents.purpose: Gets the log of joins and leaves of a whole campaign, with date, group and country, filtered by event type, dates or groups.

group.participants.name: List a group's participants
group.participants.purpose: Use it to list the participants of a group, filtered by phone, whether they are admins or whether they can be promoted to admin.

group.participantEvents.name: List a group's joins and leaves
group.participantEvents.purpose: Shows who joined and left a group and when, with country and filters by date or event type.

device.index.name: List numbers
device.index.purpose: Lists your WhatsApp numbers with their provider, whether they are connected (connected) and active, and their health, and gets the IDs the other operations use. External Reference finds the number a connect link created.

device.show.name: Get a number
device.show.purpose: Use it to see a number's data: alias, provider, WABA, username, whether it is connected and its health.

device.update.name: Update a number
device.update.purpose: Updates a number's data (alias, color, image) or completes its WhatsApp Business data, such as the WABA and phone number ID, and the Conversions API consent.

device.destroy.name: Delete a number
device.destroy.purpose: Use it to remove a number from the account for good. It cannot be undone and needs the accounts:operate permission.

device.reset.name: Restart a number's session
device.reset.purpose: Restarts a number's WhatsApp session from scratch; the QR code has to be scanned again afterwards. It cannot be undone and needs accounts:operate.

device.clean.name: Clean a number
device.clean.purpose: Cleans a number's WhatsApp session: the QR code has to be scanned again afterwards. It cannot be undone and needs accounts:operate.

device.messageQueue.name: Get the message queue
device.messageQueue.purpose: Use it to see the messages waiting in a number's queue, for example to understand why something has not gone out yet.

device.deleteMessageQueue.name: Delete messages from the queue
device.deleteMessageQueue.purpose: Removes specific messages from the queue, by their UID, before they are sent, for example one queued by mistake.

device.getQueueCount.name: Count the messages in the queue
device.getQueueCount.purpose: Use it to monitor how many messages a number has queued, for example to detect jams.

device.clearQueue.name: Empty the message queue
device.clearQueue.purpose: Empties a number's whole queue when piled-up sends have to be stopped. It drops the messages without a record; it cannot be undone and needs accounts:operate.

device.status.name: Get the connection status
device.status.purpose: Use it to check a number's connection status, for example before starting sends or to monitor your numbers.

deviceHealth.show.name: Get a number's health
deviceHealth.show.purpose: Use it to see the health of a WhatsApp Cloud number (status, identity, throughput level and change history) from the last stored data, without asking Meta.

deviceHealth.refresh.name: Refresh a number's health
deviceHealth.refresh.purpose: Asks Meta for a number's current health; the response says whether it was really refreshed or returned the previous data because of the 60-second wait or another refresh in progress.

deviceConnectionEvent.index.name: Get the connection history
deviceConnectionEvent.index.purpose: Use it to see when a number connected and disconnected, newest event first, for example to investigate outages.

deviceUsername.show.name: Get the username
deviceUsername.show.purpose: Use it to see the WhatsApp username reserved for a number, both the one Meta reports and the one stored in Funnelchat.

deviceUsername.store.name: Set the username
deviceUsername.store.purpose: Reserves a WhatsApp username at Meta for one of your numbers.

deviceUsername.suggestions.name: Suggest usernames
deviceUsername.suggestions.purpose: Use it to ask Meta for username suggestions before reserving one.

webhookEventCatalog.index.name: List event types
webhookEventCatalog.index.purpose: Use it to know the catalog of events of the account and its numbers, which are emitted already and which are planned, with an example body of each.

deviceProvisioning.store.name: Create a number to connect by QR
deviceProvisioning.store.purpose: Creates a number of the account that connects by scanning a QR code with the WhatsApp app. Then read its QR with "Get a number's QR code", or send your customer a connect link instead.

deviceProvisioning.qr.name: Get a number's QR code
deviceProvisioning.qr.purpose: Gets the QR code that connects a QR number: scan it with the WhatsApp app (Linked devices). Once connected, connected is true and the device.connected event arrives.

connectLink.store.name: Create a connect link
connectLink.store.purpose: Creates a single-use link for your customer to connect a WhatsApp number to your account from a Funnelchat page, without the panel: send them the url of the response.

connectLink.index.name: List connect links
connectLink.index.purpose: Lists the account's connect links, newest first and without their url, filtered by status or by your reference.

connectLink.show.name: Get a connect link
connectLink.show.purpose: Gets a connect link's current status (pending, completed, failed, expired or revoked) and, once completed, the device_id of the number it connected.

connectLink.destroy.name: Revoke a connect link
connectLink.destroy.purpose: Revokes a pending connect link: its page then answers that the link no longer works. If the page had already created a number that is not connected yet, that number is deleted.

apiGroupAction.sendMessage.name: Send a message to a group
apiGroupAction.sendMessage.purpose: Sends a text or one media file to a WhatsApp group now, from one of your numbers. It answers at once with an action_id; the message goes out right after.

apiGroupAction.show.name: Get a group action
apiGroupAction.show.purpose: Gets the status (queued, running, completed or failed) and the result of a group action, such as a message sent to a group.

contactCard.store.name: Send a contact card
contactCard.store.purpose: Sends a contact up to 5 contact cards of the account, one message per card.

conversation.sendMessage.name: Send a message to a contact
conversation.sendMessage.purpose: Use it to send a contact a text message or a file from one of your numbers, optionally replying to a previous message, with options or a link preview.

forwardMessage.store.name: Forward a message
forwardMessage.store.purpose: Use it to forward a message of a conversation to up to 5 other contacts.

message.sendMessage.name: Send a message
message.sendMessage.purpose: Sends a message to a contact from one of your numbers, given the contact and the number in the body.

messageTemplate.send.name: Send a template
messageTemplate.send.purpose: Use it to send an approved WhatsApp template to a contact, with its variables, also outside the 24-hour window.

message.showMessage.name: Get a message
message.showMessage.purpose: Use it to check the status of a message by its ID (the one the send returned): queued, sent, delivered, read or failed, with the error and your client_reference.

whatsappFormSend.store.name: Send a form to a contact
whatsappFormSend.store.purpose: Use it to send a published form to a contact. When they complete it, the whatsapp_form.completed event arrives with the answers.

webhookSubscription.index.name: List webhook subscriptions
webhookSubscription.index.purpose: Use it to see all the subscriptions of the account, also the ones other integrations or people created.

webhookSubscription.store.name: Create a webhook subscription
webhookSubscription.store.purpose: Use it to register an https URL and choose the events it receives. The response has the secret only once: keep it to verify the signature.

webhookSubscription.show.name: Get a webhook subscription
webhookSubscription.show.purpose: Use it to see the URL, events, filter and status of a subscription. It never includes the secret.

webhookSubscription.update.name: Update a webhook subscription
webhookSubscription.update.purpose: Use it to change the URL (for example, when your tunnel changes), the events or the filter, or to pause and resume a subscription. It replaces the whole subscription and the secret does not change.

webhookSubscription.destroy.name: Delete a webhook subscription
webhookSubscription.destroy.purpose: Use it to remove a subscription. Its events and delivery history are deleted with it. Do not delete the ones you do not recognize: they may belong to another integration of the account.

webhookSubscriptionDelivery.index.name: List a subscription's deliveries
webhookSubscriptionDelivery.index.purpose: Use it to review each delivery attempt of a subscription: HTTP status, error and duration, newest first.

webhookSubscriptionTest.test.name: Send a test event
webhookSubscriptionTest.test.purpose: Use it to test your receiver: sends a single webhook.test event signed like a real one, without retries, and keeps it in the history.

message.markMessageRead.name: Mark a message as read
message.markMessageRead.purpose: Marks a message the contact sent you as read on WhatsApp (the contact sees the blue ticks), and updates the conversation's unread state as the panel does.

message.typingIndicator.name: Show "typing…" to a contact
message.typingIndicator.purpose: Shows the contact that you are typing, on their latest message, for example while your system prepares the answer. Only WhatsApp Cloud numbers.

message.templateMetrics.name: Get a template's metrics
message.templateMetrics.purpose: Gets what Meta reports for a template of an official number, day by day (UTC) and in total: sent, delivered and read, clicks per button and, when Meta reports it, the cost.

apiGroupAction.create.name: Create a group
apiGroupAction.create.purpose: Creates a WhatsApp group from one of your numbers, with up to 20 initial participants, a description and, on an official number, approval to join.

apiGroupAction.addParticipants.name: Add participants to a group
apiGroupAction.addParticipants.purpose: Adds up to 20 phones to a group, from a number that administers it.

apiGroupAction.removeParticipants.name: Remove participants from a group
apiGroupAction.removeParticipants.purpose: Removes up to 20 phones from a group in one WhatsApp operation.

apiGroupAction.promoteAdmins.name: Make participants admins
apiGroupAction.promoteAdmins.purpose: Makes up to 20 phones admins of a group; a phone that is not in the group is added first. QR numbers only.

apiGroupAction.demoteAdmins.name: Remove the admin role
apiGroupAction.demoteAdmins.purpose: Takes the admin role away from up to 20 phones of a group. QR numbers only.

apiGroupAction.updateName.name: Rename a group
apiGroupAction.updateName.purpose: Changes the name of a group in WhatsApp, as you send it (up to 100 characters, without campaign numbering).

apiGroupAction.updateDescription.name: Change a group's description
apiGroupAction.updateDescription.purpose: Changes the description of a group in WhatsApp (up to 2048 characters); an empty one removes it.

apiGroupAction.updatePhoto.name: Change a group's photo
apiGroupAction.updatePhoto.purpose: Changes the photo of a group from an https URL of a jpg, jpeg or png image. QR numbers only.

apiGroupAction.updateSettings.name: Change who can write in a group
apiGroupAction.updateSettings.purpose: Sets whether the members can send messages; blocking it also leaves only the admins editing the group's information. QR numbers only.

apiGroupAction.renewInviteLink.name: Renew a group's invite link
apiGroupAction.renewInviteLink.purpose: Renews the invite link of a group: an official number revokes it and WhatsApp makes a new one; a QR number reads the current one again without revoking it.

apiGroupAction.inviteLink.name: Get a group's live invite link
apiGroupAction.inviteLink.purpose: Gets the current invite link of a group, read live from WhatsApp with the number given in Number ID.

apiGroupAction.joinRequests.name: List a group's join requests
apiGroupAction.joinRequests.purpose: Lists the pending requests to join a group (up to 100, in WhatsApp's order), read live with the number given in Number ID.

apiGroupAction.approveJoinRequests.name: Approve join requests
apiGroupAction.approveJoinRequests.purpose: Approves pending requests to join a group, for the given phones, if they fit in the free places of the group (capacity_full otherwise).

apiGroupAction.rejectJoinRequests.name: Reject join requests
apiGroupAction.rejectJoinRequests.purpose: Rejects pending requests to join a group, for the given phones.

v2.apiGroupImport.name: Follow a group
v2.apiGroupImport.purpose: Starts following a WhatsApp group of your number without writing to it: imports it into your account, and from then on you get who joins and who leaves. If it is already in your account, it is not imported again.

messageTemplate.sync.name: Bring templates from Meta
messageTemplate.sync.purpose: Use it when you created or changed a template directly in Meta and it does not show in your list yet (they arrive on their own once a day): it brings them now. Official WhatsApp numbers only.

broadcast.index.name: List broadcasts
broadcast.index.purpose: Use it to build a panel or report of your broadcasts: filter by number, status, folder, send type or scheduled date and find the one you want.

broadcast.contacts.name: Find the contacts for a broadcast
broadcast.contacts.purpose: Use it to preview a broadcast's audience before creating it: give it the filters (tags, countries, board stage, lead score) and it returns, page by page, the contacts that would be in it.

broadcast.contactsCount.name: Count the contacts for a broadcast
broadcast.contactsCount.purpose: Use it to size a broadcast's audience with the same filters you find its contacts with, without bringing them one by one. The specification does not describe the shape of the response.

broadcast.costTiers.name: Get the cost tiers
broadcast.costTiers.purpose: Use it to see the current cost tiers and the date the prices were last updated, as a reference to estimate what a broadcast can cost.

broadcast.moveToFolder.name: Move broadcasts to a folder
broadcast.moveToFolder.purpose: Use it to sort broadcasts in bulk: it moves several of them to a folder in one call, for example to group them by campaign or by customer.

broadcast.show.name: Get a broadcast
broadcast.show.purpose: Use it to see a broadcast's full setup: number, template, folder and the audience filters it used (tags, countries, board, lead score).

broadcast.destroy.name: Delete a broadcast
broadcast.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a scheduled broadcast before its send time. One already sent or going out cannot be deleted (422); a paused one is closed by cancelling it.

broadcast.statistics.name: Get a broadcast's statistics
broadcast.statistics.purpose: Use it to measure a broadcast's result: delivered, read, replied, failed, pending and skipped (with the reason), plus the clicks on each button.

broadcast.cost.name: Get a broadcast's cost
broadcast.cost.purpose: Use it to know what a broadcast costs: the estimate before sending and the cost calculated for what was sent, by market, and whether the figure is still partial.

broadcast.broadcastContacts.name: List a broadcast's contacts
broadcast.broadcastContacts.purpose: Use it to get the recipients of a broadcast, for example to match them with your CRM or to audit who it was sent to.

broadcast.cancel.name: Cancel a broadcast
broadcast.cancel.purpose: Use it to close a broadcast that is going out or was paused: it ends there, with partial failures, and broadcast.finished arrives with reason cancelled. In any other status, scheduled included, it answers 409: a scheduled one is deleted.

broadcast.broadcastMessages.name: List a broadcast's messages
broadcast.broadcastMessages.purpose: Use it to see a broadcast recipient by recipient: the status of each message, why it was skipped and when it was sent. Filter with tab to see the delivered, read, replied, failed or skipped ones.

broadcastFolder.index.name: List broadcast folders
broadcastFolder.index.purpose: Use it to get the broadcast folders with how many broadcasts each one has, for example to copy that organization in your system.

broadcastFolder.store.name: Create a broadcast folder
broadcastFolder.store.purpose: Use it to create a folder and group broadcasts by campaign, customer or whatever you use.

broadcastFolder.update.name: Rename a broadcast folder
broadcastFolder.update.purpose: Use it to rename a broadcast folder.

broadcastFolder.destroy.name: Delete a broadcast folder
broadcastFolder.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a broadcast folder you no longer use.

contact.addTags.name: Add tags to contacts
contact.addTags.purpose: Use it to tag one or more contacts from your system, up to 200 per call. One tag on one contact starts, as in the panel, that tag's "Tag added" automation; several in the same call start none.

contact.removeTags.name: Remove tags from contacts
contact.removeTags.purpose: Use it to remove tags from one or more contacts, up to 200 per call, for example when something changed in your system. It starts no automation.

contactAutomation.pause.name: Pause a contact's automations
contactAutomation.pause.purpose: Use it to pause a contact in the account's automations; conversations and broadcasts can filter the paused contacts. The pause does not expire nor lift on its own.

contactAutomation.flows.name: List a contact's flows
contactAutomation.flows.purpose: Use it to know which automation flows a contact is in and whether any of them is still running.

contactLeadScore.show.name: Get a contact's lead score
contactLeadScore.show.purpose: Use it to know how hot a lead is: score, category, confidence, whether it is disqualified and the history of signals behind it, page by page with a cursor.

flow.contactFlowHistory.name: List a contact's flow runs
flow.contactFlowHistory.purpose: Use it to see the history of a contact's flow runs, filtered by status (running, completed, invalidated, cancelled) and dates. Useful to find out why a contact did or did not get an automation.

flow.cancelContactFlow.name: Cancel a flow run
flow.cancelContactFlow.purpose: Use it to stop a flow that is running for a contact, for example when your system finds out the contact already bought or asked not to get more messages. The ID of the run comes from the contact's runs or from the flow's contacts.

flow.index.name: List flows
flow.index.purpose: Use it to list your automation flows filtered by folder, trigger, status, number or date, for example to show them in your product or to audit them.

flow.activeContacts.name: Count a flow's running contacts
flow.activeContacts.purpose: Use it to know how many contacts are inside a flow right now, for example before editing or turning it off.

flow.pausedContacts.name: Count a flow's paused contacts
flow.pausedContacts.purpose: Use it to know how many contacts of a flow are paused, for example for a dashboard of your automations.

flow.pausedContactsList.name: List a flow's paused contacts
flow.pausedContactsList.purpose: Use it to see who is paused in a flow, with a search, for example to review those cases one by one.

flow.flowContactsList.name: List a flow's contacts
flow.flowContactsList.purpose: Use it to see every contact that went through a flow, filtered by status (running, completed, invalidated, cancelled) and dates. Good to measure its result.

folder.index.name: List flow folders
folder.index.purpose: Use it to list the folders the flows are organized in, with their hierarchy and number of flows, for example to filter flows by folder.

folder.store.name: Create a flow folder
folder.store.purpose: Use it to create a folder (or a subfolder, with parent_id) to organize your flows.

folder.show.name: Get a flow folder
folder.show.purpose: Use it to see a flow folder with its subfolders and how many flows it has.

folder.update.name: Update a flow folder
folder.update.purpose: Use it to rename a flow folder or to move it into another one by changing parent_id.

folder.destroy.name: Delete a flow folder
folder.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a flow folder you no longer need.

kanbanSetting.index.name: List boards
kanbanSetting.index.purpose: Use it to list your kanban boards and get their IDs, which you need to move contacts between stages or to filter conversations and broadcasts by board.

kanbanSetting.store.name: Create a board
kanbanSetting.store.purpose: Use it to create a kanban board, based on stages or on tags, for example to model your sales or support funnel inside Funnelchat.

kanbanSetting.show.name: Get a board
kanbanSetting.show.purpose: Use it to see a board's setup: mode, stages, days after which a contact counts as stalled, and the value and profit fields linked to it.

kanbanSetting.update.name: Update a board
kanbanSetting.update.purpose: Use it to adjust an existing board: name, structure, stalled days, view, icon or whether it is coloured by lead score.

kanbanSetting.destroy.name: Delete a board
kanbanSetting.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a kanban board you no longer use.

kanbanSetting.members.name: Check which contacts are on a board
kanbanSetting.members.purpose: Use it to check in one call which of a set of contacts are on a board, for example before moving or adding them.

kanbanStage.contactStages.name: Get a contact's stages
kanbanStage.contactStages.purpose: Use it to see a contact's stage on each board, useful to show its progress in the funnel inside your CRM.

kanbanStage.moveContact.name: Move a contact to a stage
kanbanStage.moveContact.purpose: Use it to move a contact to another stage of the board when something happens in your system, for example when a payment arrives or a demo is booked.

kanbanStage.bulkMove.name: Move contacts to a stage
kanbanStage.bulkMove.purpose: Use it to move many contacts to the same stage at once, for example when closing a campaign or importing results.

kanbanStage.removeContact.name: Remove a contact from a board
kanbanStage.removeContact.purpose: Use it to take a contact off a board when it is no longer in that process, for example if it was lost or discarded.

kanbanStage.bulkRemove.name: Remove contacts from a board
kanbanStage.bulkRemove.purpose: Use it to take several contacts off a board in one call.

kanbanStage.store.name: Create a stage
kanbanStage.store.purpose: Use it to add a new stage to a board, after an existing stage.

kanbanStage.reorder.name: Reorder the stages
kanbanStage.reorder.purpose: Use it to change the order of a board's stages by sending the list of IDs in the order you want.

kanbanStage.update.name: Rename a stage
kanbanStage.update.purpose: Use it to rename a stage of a board.

kanbanStage.destroy.name: Delete a stage
kanbanStage.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a stage of a board; with reassign_to_stage_id its contacts go to another stage.

kanbanStage.contacts.name: List a stage's contacts
kanbanStage.contacts.purpose: Use it to bring the contacts of a stage with filters (agent, value, stalled, tags, lead score, dates), for example to follow them up or to report on the funnel.

leadScoreDistribution.show.name: Get the lead score distribution
leadScoreDistribution.show.purpose: Use it to see how your contacts are spread among hot, warm, cold and not enough data, with the current thresholds. Good for a lead quality dashboard.

leadScoreSettings.show.name: Get the lead score settings
leadScoreSettings.show.purpose: Use it to read how your account's lead score is calculated: hot and warm thresholds, minimum signals, hysteresis, decay and rules.

leadScoreSettings.update.name: Set the lead score settings
leadScoreSettings.update.purpose: Use it to fit the lead score to your business: category thresholds, minimum signals, hysteresis, decay over the days and rules. It replaces the whole setup at once: send all of it. Only the key of the account owner.

leadScoreSettings.adjust.name: Adjust a contact's lead score
leadScoreSettings.adjust.purpose: Use it to add or take points from a contact's lead score by hand, with a reason, for example when your sales team confirms interest through another channel.

mac.status.name: Get your monthly active contacts usage
mac.status.purpose: Use it to know how many monthly active contacts (MAC) your account has in the cycle, its limit, how many are left and the share used, so you act before the account is blocked.

mac.contacts.name: List your monthly active contacts
mac.contacts.purpose: Use it to see which contacts count as MAC, useful to understand what is using up your quota.

mac.contactsHistory.name: List the history of your monthly active contacts
mac.contactsHistory.purpose: Use it to see the history of MACs and how the usage evolved over time.

paymentProduct.index.name: List a payment platform's products
paymentProduct.index.purpose: Use it to list the products of a payment platform with their external ID and name, for example to match them with the sales Funnelchat reports.

quickReply.index.name: List quick replies
quickReply.index.purpose: Use it to list the account's quick replies, for example to offer them in your own support interface.

quickReply.store.name: Create a quick reply
quickReply.store.purpose: Use it to create a quick reply with text or a file and choose who sees it (visibility and agents), so the team answers the frequent questions faster.

quickReply.show.name: Get a quick reply
quickReply.show.purpose: Use it to see a quick reply with its content, its type and the agents who have it.

quickReply.update.name: Update a quick reply
quickReply.update.purpose: Use it to update the content or the visibility of a quick reply.

quickReply.destroy.name: Delete a quick reply
quickReply.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a quick reply that is no longer used.

salesDashboard.metrics.name: Get the sales metrics
salesDashboard.metrics.purpose: Use it to get sales metrics of the last 7, 30 or 90 days: totals by currency, distinct buyers and repurchase rate. Good for a sales dashboard.

salesDashboard.funnel.name: Get the sales funnel
salesDashboard.funnel.purpose: Use it to see the funnel from conversations to qualified leads to purchases in a 7, 30 or 90 day window, and measure how much your WhatsApp service converts.

salesDashboard.byPlatform.name: Get the sales by platform
salesDashboard.byPlatform.purpose: Use it to compare the sales by payment platform in the chosen window and see which platforms are connected.

salesDashboard.index.name: List sales
salesDashboard.index.purpose: Use it to bring the sales in detail (product, amount in the minor unit of its currency, platform, status, buyer and attribution) of the last 7, 30 or 90 days, for example to reconcile them with your system.

ticket.index.name: List tickets
ticket.index.purpose: Use it to list the account's tickets filtered by status (1 open, 2 closed) or by assigned user, for example to build a view of pending cases.

ticket.store.name: Create a ticket
ticket.store.purpose: Use it to open a ticket about a contact (title and description) and assign it to a user of the team, for example when your system detects a complaint.

ticket.show.name: Get a ticket
ticket.show.purpose: Use it to see a ticket with its contact, the person in charge, the description and the due date.

ticket.update.name: Update a ticket
ticket.update.purpose: Use it to fix or extend the title and the description of a ticket.

ticket.assignTicketToUser.name: Assign a ticket
ticket.assignTicketToUser.purpose: Use it to assign a ticket to another user of the team.

ticket.closeTicket.name: Close a ticket
ticket.closeTicket.purpose: Use it to close a ticket when the case is solved.

ticket.reOpenTicket.name: Reopen a ticket
ticket.reOpenTicket.purpose: Use it to reopen a closed ticket if the case needs attention again.

user.show.name: Get a team member
user.show.purpose: Use it to see the data of a person of your team, for example their name to show who handles a conversation.

user.index.name: List your team
user.index.purpose: Use it to list the account's agents and get their IDs, which you need to assign conversations or tickets and to filter by agent.

whatsappForm.index.name: List forms
whatsappForm.index.purpose: Use it to see the WhatsApp forms of the account, one row per form with its current version, sends and responses.

whatsappForm.store.name: Create a form
whatsappForm.store.purpose: Use it to create a draft form from a template (blank starts it empty) for one or more numbers. Then it is edited, validated and published.

whatsappForm.templates.name: List form templates
whatsappForm.templates.purpose: Use it to see which templates a form can be created from.

whatsappForm.show.name: Get a form
whatsappForm.show.purpose: Use it to see a version of a form with its definition, its lint, its versions and its numbers.

whatsappForm.update.name: Save a form
whatsappForm.update.purpose: Use it to save the definition of a draft (screens and questions). A published form is not edited: create a new version.

whatsappForm.destroy.name: Delete a draft form
whatsappForm.destroy.purpose: Use it to delete a draft version. A published one answers 409 PUBLISHED.

whatsappForm.numbersIndex.name: Get a form's numbers
whatsappForm.numbersIndex.purpose: Use it to see which numbers the form is on and the status of its publication on each one.

whatsappForm.addNumber.name: Add a number to a form
whatsappForm.addNumber.purpose: Use it to add a number to the form; if it is already published, it is published on that number too.

whatsappForm.removeNumber.name: Remove a number from a form
whatsappForm.removeNumber.purpose: Use it to take a number off the form. The main number cannot be removed (422 PRIMARY_NUMBER).

whatsappForm.retryNumbers.name: Retry publishing on the numbers
whatsappForm.retryNumbers.purpose: Use it to retry the publication on the numbers where it failed.

whatsappForm.storeVersion.name: Create a new version of a form
whatsappForm.storeVersion.purpose: Use it to edit a published form: creates a new draft from it, or returns the draft that already existed (created: false).

whatsappForm.sync.name: Validate a form with Meta
whatsappForm.sync.purpose: Use it to upload the draft to Meta and get its validation errors before publishing.

whatsappForm.publish.name: Publish a form
whatsappForm.publish.purpose: Use it to publish the draft on its numbers. With errors it answers 422 LINT; if Meta rejects it, 502 META.

whatsappForm.definition.name: Get a form's published definition
whatsappForm.definition.purpose: Use it to read the definition of the current version of a form.

whatsappForm.versions.name: List a form's versions
whatsappForm.versions.purpose: Use it to see all the versions of a form with their status and responses.

whatsappForm.responses.name: List a form's responses
whatsappForm.responses.purpose: Use it to get the responses of a form, across all its versions, with the contact and the value of each field.

whatsappForm.response.name: Get a form's response
whatsappForm.response.purpose: Use it to see a full response: each answer of the contact, the times of the send and what the form did.

whatsappForm.metrics.name: Get a form's metrics
whatsappForm.metrics.purpose: Use it to see how many forms were sent, delivered, read and completed, and the rates.

campaign.index.name: List campaigns
campaign.index.purpose: Use it to list the WhatsApp group campaigns of your account, with a search by name, and get their IDs to look up their groups, participants or statistics.

campaign.show.name: Get a campaign
campaign.show.purpose: Use it to see a campaign's full setup: its groups, admins, redirect link, traffic distribution, pixel and the groups that are disconnected or failing.

campaignConditional.index.name: List a campaign's conditions
campaignConditional.index.purpose: Use it to know a campaign's conditional rules: which conditions it checks and which URL or group it redirects to when they are met.

campaign.availableGroups.name: List the groups you can add to a campaign
campaign.availableGroups.purpose: Use it to see which groups, announcement groups or channels of your account can be added to a campaign, filtered by number or by name.

campaign.groups.name: List a campaign's groups
campaign.groups.purpose: Use it to list a campaign's groups with their status, origin and admin connection, for example to spot full or disconnected groups.

campaign.indexPipelines.name: List a campaign's pipelines
campaign.indexPipelines.purpose: Use it to follow the pipelines of operations on a campaign's groups, with how many actions are in each status and their progress, filtered by status or action type.

campaign.showPipeline.name: Get a pipeline
campaign.showPipeline.purpose: Use it to see the progress of a bulk operation: how many actions are scheduled, running, completed or failed, and the share done.

operationPlan.config.name: Get the limits of an operation plan
operationPlan.config.purpose: Use it to know the limits a campaign's operation plans are scheduled with: daily cap, minimum spacing, time window and whether weekends are allowed.

operationPlan.index.name: List a campaign's operation plans
operationPlan.index.purpose: Use it to list a campaign's scheduled operation plans, with their status, date range, daily cap and number of operations.

operationPlan.show.name: Get an operation plan
operationPlan.show.purpose: Use it to see an operation plan in detail: status, time zone, time window, date range, daily cap and spacing between operations.

campaign.actions.name: List a campaign's actions
campaign.actions.purpose: Use it to audit the actions run on a campaign's groups through the WhatsApp session: what changed (old and new value), status, attempts and dates.

groupManagement.actionGroup.name: List an action's groups
groupManagement.actionGroup.purpose: Use it to see which groups an action was applied to and with which result on each one, useful to find the ones that failed.

scheduledMessage.index.name: List scheduled sends
scheduledMessage.index.purpose: Use it to list your scheduled sends to groups with their status, date, recurrence and campaigns, filtered by folder or by the ones that need a number reconnected.

scheduledMessage.show.name: Get a scheduled send
scheduledMessage.show.purpose: Use it to see a scheduled send in full: date, status, audience, reads, plays, link clicks and sending speed.

scheduledMessage.groups.name: List a scheduled send's groups
scheduledMessage.groups.purpose: Use it to know which groups a scheduled send goes to, filtered by name or status.

scheduledMessage.readedAndPlayedRates.name: Get a scheduled send's reads and plays
scheduledMessage.readedAndPlayedRates.purpose: Use it to measure a send's reach: total audience, how many read it and how many played its content, in total or by run.

scheduledMessage.runs.name: List a recurring send's runs
scheduledMessage.runs.purpose: Use it to see each run of a recurring send that already went out, with how many groups went well and how many with an error.

scheduledMessageFolder.index.name: List scheduled send folders
scheduledMessageFolder.index.purpose: Use it to get the folders the scheduled sends are organized in and filter the list by folder.

scheduledMessage.responses.name: List the answers to a scheduled send
scheduledMessage.responses.purpose: Use it to collect the answers to the polls or events of a send: who answered, in which group, what they chose and when.

scheduledMessage.responseTags.name: List the tags a scheduled send gives to who answers
scheduledMessage.responseTags.purpose: Use it to see, for each poll or event of the send, which tags are applied to who answers by the option chosen, and how many answers were left without a tag.

stats.participantStats.name: Get participants by period
stats.participantStats.purpose: Use it to chart participants joining and leaving by hour, day or month in your groups or campaigns, in a range of up to 366 days.

stats.activeParticipants.name: Get active participants
stats.activeParticipants.purpose: Use it to see how active and inactive participants evolve by period in your groups or campaigns, for example to follow how active your community is.

stats.groupStats.name: Get your groups by status
stats.groupStats.purpose: Use it to follow how many groups you have in each status over time, by hour, day or month.

stats.clickStats.name: Get the clicks on your links
stats.clickStats.purpose: Use it to measure the clicks on your groups' or campaigns' links by period and compare which ones bring more traffic.

stats.statsRecords.name: List the click records
stats.statsRecords.purpose: Use it to download the individual records of your groups or campaigns (country, device, browser, referrer, group and contact data when there is any), filtered by date, country or device.

stats.countryMetrics.name: Get the metrics by country
stats.countryMetrics.purpose: Use it to analyse your audience by country: contacts, clicks, joins, join rate and leaves in your groups or campaigns.

capiConnection.dataset.name: Set up a number's dataset
capiConnection.dataset.purpose: Use it to get the Meta Conversions API dataset of a number's WABA ready, creating it or getting it back if it already existed. Only the account owner can do it.

capiConnection.test.name: Test the Conversions API connection
capiConnection.test.purpose: Use it to check the Conversions API connection: it checks the token's permissions and that the WABA has a dataset, without sending test events, and gives you the link to the Events Manager.

capiConnection.datasets.name: List your Conversions API datasets
capiConnection.datasets.purpose: Use it to see, without asking Meta, the last saved status of the Conversions API of each WhatsApp Business account of yours that already has a dataset.

customDomain.index.name: List custom domains
customDomain.index.purpose: Use it to see your own domains with their status, the SSL and the DNS records you have to add.

customDomain.store.name: Add a custom domain
customDomain.store.purpose: Use it to register a domain of yours, such as go.mybrand.com, for Funnelchat's redirection service. Then create in your DNS the records it gives so it is validated.

customDomain.verify.name: Verify a custom domain
customDomain.verify.purpose: Use it after publishing the DNS records to validate the domain now, instead of waiting for the automatic check.

customDomain.switchValidationMethod.name: Change how the certificate is validated
customDomain.switchValidationMethod.purpose: Use it to switch the SSL validation method between HTTP and TXT; use TXT while the CNAME does not point yet and the HTTP validation cannot complete.

customDomain.destroy.name: Delete a custom domain
customDomain.destroy.purpose: Use it to remove a custom domain: it stops being used at once. It cannot be undone.

whatsAppBusinessAccount.index.name: List your WhatsApp Business accounts
whatsAppBusinessAccount.index.purpose: Use it to see the WhatsApp Business accounts of your official numbers, each one with its numbers and the daily message limit Meta gives its business portfolio. QR numbers do not show.

whatsAppBusinessAccount.show.name: Get a WhatsApp Business account
whatsAppBusinessAccount.show.purpose: Use it to see one of the WhatsApp Business accounts of your official numbers, by its Meta ID: its numbers and the daily message limit they share.

whatsappCost.index.name: Get your WhatsApp costs
whatsappCost.index.purpose: Use it to see how much you spent on WhatsApp in a month (the current one or the one you give in month), for example to control costs or reconcile your billing.

flow.show.name: Get a flow
flow.show.purpose: Use it to see a flow's setup: whether it is active and valid, how many times it ran and what triggers it (type, values and numbers).

flow.nodes.name: List a flow's nodes
flow.nodes.purpose: Use it to read a flow's nodes and how they are chained, for example to document or draw the automation outside Funnelchat.

flow.activeContactsList.name: List a flow's running contacts
flow.activeContactsList.purpose: Use it to know who is inside a flow right now, with a search, for example to review cases or cancel single runs.

scheduledMessage.groupMessages.name: Get a scheduled send's result by group
scheduledMessage.groupMessages.purpose: Use it to see how the send went in each group: status, error, reads, plays, reactions and clicks, optionally for one run of a recurring send.

GET /api/v1/me.name: Get my account
GET /api/v1/me.purpose: Use it to identify the account behind your key and know its plan, its limits of numbers and agents, the role, the time zone and the language, for example when connecting your integration.

alertCampaign.index.name: List the campaigns for alerts
alertCampaign.index.purpose: Use it to list, with a search by name, the group campaigns you can choose when setting up alerts such as the daily report.

alertCatalog.index.name: List the alert types
alertCatalog.index.purpose: Use it to know which alerts exist (disconnected numbers, MAC usage, charges, campaigns, groups and more), which ones are critical and what they mean, before turning them on for a destination.

alertDailyReport.show.name: Get the daily report settings
alertDailyReport.show.purpose: Use it to see how the daily report is set up: whether it is on, at what time it is sent and which campaigns it includes.

alertDailyReport.update.name: Set the daily report
alertDailyReport.update.purpose: Use it to turn on or adjust the daily report: the time it is sent and whether it covers every campaign or only some.

alertDestination.index.name: List alert destinations
alertDestination.index.purpose: Use it to see where your alerts arrive (phones or webhooks), whether they are verified and which alerts each one has on.

alertDestination.store.name: Create an alert destination
alertDestination.store.purpose: Use it to add a phone or an https webhook that gets your operational alerts. Then it has to be verified; for a webhook, keep the signing secret, which is shown only once.

alertDestination.update.name: Update an alert destination
alertDestination.update.purpose: Use it to rename an alert destination or, for a webhook, fix its URL; changing the URL makes it be verified again.

alertDestination.destroy.name: Delete an alert destination
alertDestination.destroy.purpose: Use it to stop sending alerts to a phone or a webhook; its alert settings are deleted too.

alertOtp.send.name: Send a verification code
alertOtp.send.purpose: Use it to send (or send again) the verification code to an alert phone, the step before you can turn alerts on for it. There is a wait between sends and a cap per hour.

alertOtp.verify.name: Verify the code
alertOtp.verify.purpose: Use it to confirm an alert phone with the code it got; once verified, you can turn alerts on for it.

alertQuietHour.show.name: Get the quiet hours
alertQuietHour.show.purpose: Use it to see whether quiet hours are set for the alerts and between which hours they apply.

alertQuietHour.update.name: Set the quiet hours
alertQuietHour.update.purpose: Use it to set a time range without alerts, for example at night, or to turn it off.

alertSetting.upsert.name: Turn an alert on or off
alertSetting.upsert.purpose: Use it to choose which alerts each verified destination gets, turning them on or off one by one, for example a number's disconnection or a failed payment.

alertWebhookTest.test.name: Test a webhook destination
alertWebhookTest.test.purpose: Use it to check that your alerts webhook answers: it sends a test payload and gives back the status and the latency.
